title: BOM 是 3 个真实字节：utf-8 vs utf-8-sig
expected_output:
前 3 字节      = efbbbf
文件字节数     = 9

用 utf-8 读（不剥 BOM）:
  首字符 = '\ufeff' | 码点 = U+FEFF
  字符串长度 = 3

用 utf-8-sig 读:
  内容 = '中文'
  字符串长度 = 2

要点: BOM 是 3 个真实字节 U+FEFF; 当成内容会污染 JSON 解析、首字段名比较
code:
from pathlib import Path

p = Path("bom.txt")
p.write_text("中文", encoding="utf-8-sig")

raw = p.read_bytes()
print("前 3 字节      =", raw[:3].hex())
print("文件字节数     =", len(raw))
print()

print("用 utf-8 读（不剥 BOM）:")
first = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")[0]
print("  首字符 =", repr(first), "| 码点 = U+%04X" % ord(first))
print("  字符串长度 =", len(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
print()
print("用 utf-8-sig 读:")
print("  内容 =", repr(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")))
print("  字符串长度 =", len(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")))
print()
print("要点: BOM 是 3 个真实字节 U+FEFF; 当成内容会污染 JSON 解析、首字段名比较")
